# Media checklist

Pictures and clips used by the documentation. Paths are relative to `docs/media/`. Back to the [main README](../../README.md).

## 1. Generated by script (maintainers)

These files are referenced by the READMEs. They are rendered from the simulator and the datasets.

| File | Content | Used in |
|---|---|---|
| `hero.gif` | Lab sim: overview plus the three camera views during a scripted episode | Main README |
| `real_setup.jpg` | Photo of the real robot at the desk | Main README |
| `stage1_demo_scene.png` | G1 in front of the demo table | Main README, stage 1 |
| `stage1_head_stereo.png` | Side-by-side stereo head image | Stage 1 |
| `stage1_walk.gif` | Controller mode: walking and waist twist | Stage 1 |
| `stage2_wrist_hardware.png` | Glove, bracket and D405 close-up | Stage 2 |
| `stage2_wrist_views.png` | Head image and the two wrist images | Main README, stage 2 |
| `stage2_layout_pip.png` | Illustration of the `pip` headset layout | Stage 2 |
| `stage2_layout_side.png` | Illustration of the `side` headset layout | Stage 2 |
| `stage3_lab_overview.png` | The lab scene | Main README, stage 3 |
| `stage3_real_vs_sim.jpg` | Real frames next to sim frames | Stage 3 |
| `stage3_room_build.jpg` | Lab photos next to the modelled room | Stage 3 |
| `stage3_randomize.gif` | Several randomized resets | Stage 3 |
| `stage4_scripted_episode.gif` | A scripted episode with the camera views | Main README, stage 4 |
| `stage4_real_vs_sim_episode.gif` | A real and a sim episode side by side, three cameras | Main README, stage 4, stage 5 |

## 2. Shots only a person can take

These cannot be rendered. They need the headset or the real robot.

| Shot | How to take it | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Through-the-headset screenshot of the `pip` layout | In the Quest: hold the Meta button and press the right trigger (screenshot), or use the casting / recording function | Replace `stage2_layout_pip.png` |
| Through-the-headset screenshot of the `side` layout | Same, after pressing X once | Replace `stage2_layout_side.png` |
| Through-the-headset screenshot with the floating WRIST VIEW button visible | Same, looking up and to the left | New picture in stage 2, section 3 |
| Short clip of the operator with the headset next to the sim window | Phone camera, 10-15 s | Stage 1, section 6 |
| Clip of real-robot teleop of the box task | Phone camera on a tripod, one full episode | Main README, next to `real_setup.jpg` |
| Clip of a real ACT rollout | Same view, after the first real-robot run | Stage 5, section 6 |
| Photo of the real wrist with glove, bracket and D405 | Close-up, plain background | Stage 2, next to `stage2_wrist_hardware.png` |

## 3. When taking them

- Also do the headset check that is still open: does the in-VR WRIST VIEW button react to the controller ray and to a pinch, and does the left X button switch the layout? Update the status tables in the main README and in stage 2.
- No faces or screens with private content in the frame.
- Keep GIFs short (under about 10 MB): 480 px wide, 10-15 fps.
